Northeast Bank Donates $50,000 to Junior Achievement of Maine


bdomini@northe…


Tue, 09/29/2026 - 10:58


## [Press Release](https://www.northeastbank.com/taxonomy/term/26)


**Portland, ME, September 29, 2026** – Northeast Bank recently donated $50,000 to Junior Achievement of Maine (JA) to support programs that help students across the state build skills in financial literacy, entrepreneurship, and career readiness.


The donation represents Northeast Bank’s annual support of JA Maine and delivers funding for critical programming to provide students with practical learning experiences and connections to Maine’s business community.


“Northeast Bank is proud to continue supporting Junior Achievement and the opportunities it provides to students throughout Maine,” said Robert T. Banaski, Chief Retail Banking Officer at Northeast Bank. “Financial education and career readiness give young people a stronger foundation as they consider what comes next, and we value the opportunity to support that work.”


This year also marks a new chapter in the Bank’s relationship with Junior Achievement. Robert T. Banaski was recently named Chair of the Junior Achievement of Maine Board of Directors. JA Maine has recognized his leadership, commitment to its mission, and belief in the organization as it continues its work with students across the state.


**About Northeast Bank**


Northeast Bank (NASDAQ: NBN) is headquartered in Portland, Maine and operates as both a national lender and a community bank. The Bank’s National Lending Division originates and purchases commercial real estate loans across the country. This division specializes in complex credit structures and secondary market loan acquisitions, providing tailored financing solutions to a diverse national clientele. In addition, this division includes the Bank’s Small Business segment that serves as a nationwide Small Business Administration Preferred Lender, offering government-guaranteed loans. On a regional and national level, Northeast Bank provides a comprehensive suite of depository products and cash management and treasury services through a network of seven banking centers in Maine alongside the Bank’s digital banking division, ableBanking.
